newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Price Communications unit issues debt.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Price Communications unit issues debt.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 2 - The following 144a debt issue from Price Communications Wireless Inc was priced Wednesday via lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities, according to market sources.
The issue was decreased by $25 million. A separate $50 million tranche of 10-year senior discount notes from Price Communications Cellular Holdings was dropped, market sources said.
Price Communications Wireless is an operating company of Price Communications Corp.
